issue: No edit functionality for existing listings
actual: On /my-listings, the owned listing 'Test Upcycled Chair' only exposes View, Mark Sold, and Delete actions - no Edit control. The product detail page for the same owned listing only shows a 'Manage Your Listings' button (which returns to /my-listings), with no edit option. Clicking the listing title/image does not open an edit form either. There is no discoverable way to change title, description, photos, price, category, condition, location, or upcycled status of an existing listing.

evidence: On owned listing 'Test Upcycled Chair': clicking 'Mark Sold' immediately changed status to 'Sold' and button to 'Mark Available'; toggling back restored 'Active'. Created a second listing 'Delete Me Test Item', clicked Delete which opened a 'Delete listing?' confirmation dialog with Cancel/Delete; confirming immediately removed it from My Listings (list now shows only the remaining listing).

On prod-2 (owned by Marcus Chen) and prod-1 (owned by Emma Green), viewed while signed in as Timothee Issenmann, the detail pages only exposed buyer actions (Add to Cart, Message Seller) with no Mark Sold/Delete/Manage controls. Conversely, the owned listing 'Test Upcycled Chair' page shows 'Manage Your Listings' instead of buyer actions, and only appears with Mark Sold/Delete controls on /my-listings for its actual owner.

Marked 'Test Upcycled Chair' as Sold. Browse count dropped from 11 to 10 and the item no longer appears in the browse.products list. Searching its exact title returned '0 items available / No items found'. The previously deleted listing 'Delete Me Test Item' is likewise absent from browse results. Since sold/deleted listings are excluded from browse and search (the only discovery paths to a product detail page), buyers have no way to reach these listings to add them to cart or start a purchase request.

Searching lowercase 'denim' matched title 'Vintage Denim Jacket - Size M' (1 result). Searching lowercase 'portland' matched 3 items whose location is 'Portland, OR' (case-insensitive location match). Clearing the search box restored the full 10-item unsearched result set.

Typing into the search box updated browse.count and the results list immediately (no submit needed): 'denim' -> 1 item, 'portland' -> 3 items, cleared -> 10 items, all reflected instantly on re-observation after typing.

Combined category(Furniture)+condition(New) filters -> 2 items, both Furniture/New. Adding upcycled-only kept 2 (both upcycled). Setting price min to $250 -> 1 item ($320, excluding $175). Setting max distance to 3mi -> 2 Brooklyn NY items only (2mi -> 0 items, 26mi -> all 10, proving distance filtering works). Sort 'Price: Low to High' produced ascending order $35,$45,$55,$65,$95,$125,$175,$180,$285,$320. All results satisfied active criteria in every case.

Each filter/sort change (category checkbox, condition checkbox, upcycled toggle, price slider, distance slider, sort dropdown) immediately updated browse.count and the products list without a separate submit action. Clicking 'Clear all filters' immediately restored the full unfiltered 10-item listing.

issue: Category selection from Categories page does not filter browse results
actual: Categories page showed 'Furniture 3 items'. Clicking the Furniture category card navigated to /?category=furniture, but the Browse section still displayed all 10 items (heading '10 items available') and the Furniture category checkbox in the filter sidebar was unchecked - the category filter was not applied to the results, and the shown count did not match the categories page's count.

issue: No seller-facing view of purchase requests / buyer messages
actual: As buyer, sent a 'Message Seller' purchase message on prod-1 (toast 'Message sent to seller!') and used cart 'Send Purchase Request' for prod-2 (toast 'Purchase requests sent to sellers!', cart cleared to 0 items). Logged in as Marcus Chen (seller of prod-2). Neither the user menu (only 'My Profile'/'My Listings'), My Listings page, nor the owned product detail page (prod-2, only shows 'Manage Your Listings') expose any way to view received purchase requests or buyer messages. There is no requests/inbox feature in the app, so the seller cannot view the requested item and buyer message as required.

issue: Inconsistent/incomplete auth gating on protected routes
actual: In-app action-triggered auth checks work correctly (e.g., clicking 'Add to Cart' while logged out redirects to /login). However, directly navigating to protected routes while unauthenticated (/cart, /create-listing) does NOT redirect to login or show a clear sign-in prompt - it renders a completely blank page (only notification regions in DOM, no header/nav/content at all). Console shows a React warning 'You should call navigate() in a React.useEffect(), not when your component is first rendered', indicating the redirect logic is broken/incomplete for direct route access. This leaves unauthenticated users on a dead blank page instead of a clear sign-in prompt or working redirect.
evidence: Navigated to http://localhost:6023/cart and http://localhost:6023/create-listing while logged out; both rendered blank pages with URL unchanged (no redirect to /login, no visible message); console warning about improper navigate() call during render.
